sources.title: Overture buildings: schema and provenance
sources.scope: All five councils; project snapshot 2026-08-19.0, not the latest release. OSM apartment tags are selection evidence, not verified legal use. The project export has no construction/refurbishment year, dwelling-unit count or energy rating. Floors are not dwelling counts.
sources.licence: Overture sources retain their original licences; OSM / Microsoft records here use ODbL.

sources.title: City of Melbourne 2023 building footprints
sources.scope: Melbourne geometry and model extrusion heights already used by the system. This is source provenance, not an independent height check. Tower / podium components may overlap.
sources.licence: See dataset licence; City of Melbourne attribution retained.

sources.title: CLUE buildings: age, floors and predominant use
sources.scope: 2024 survey; City of Melbourne only. Property-level points. Age/use/floors may be missing or ambiguous against multiple footprints.

sources.title: CLUE residential dwellings
sources.scope: 2024 survey; Melbourne property ID and dwelling type/count. Counts are not allocated to individual footprints. Student apartments remain a distinct type.

sources.title: Victorian Urban Development Program 2022
sources.scope: Major residential redevelopment project polygons, including all five councils. Not a complete inventory of existing apartment buildings.

sources.title: Victorian Urban Development Program 2025
sources.scope: Latest of the two retrieved project snapshots wins for a repeated project ID. Project apartment counts, maximum storeys and completion year are not building attributes.

sources.title: UDP methods and coverage
sources.scope: Projects with 10 or more dwellings. Small or older apartments can be absent. Proposed / under-construction sites are not treated as completed.

sources.title: Victorian Building and Plumbing Commission: building classes
sources.scope: Class 2, Class 3 and mixed-use distinctions guide review. Overture labels and height alone do not establish an NCC class or distinguish all serviced / student accommodation.

sources.title: Vicmap Buildings: official 3D coverage and access
sources.scope: Coverage and level of detail vary. No independent, complete, downloadable five-council height reference was obtained for this audit; height accuracy remains unvalidated.

sources.title: Building approval and end-of-project checks
sources.scope: Planning approval is not proof of completed construction or occupied use. Individual occupancy / building records remain a follow-up.

sources.title: NatHERS existing-home assessment guidance
sources.scope: Assessment / certificate evidence is needed. No building-linked energy ratings or equipment inventory were obtained across the five councils; none are inferred from age, roof shape or policy standards.

sources.title: Maribyrnong planning services and register
sources.scope: Individual planning follow-up; not a bulk building-age, dwelling or occupancy dataset. No additional complete building-attribute extract was obtained.

sources.title: Yarra planning permits and application search
sources.scope: Individual planning follow-up. No complete building-age / dwelling / energy extract was obtained.

sources.title: Stonnington planning register
sources.scope: Individual planning follow-up; application status is not occupied building use. No complete building-attribute extract was obtained.

sources.title: Port Phillip planning documentation search
sources.scope: Plans may need an individual request. The open-data catalogue lists council-asset sustainability datasets, not a complete private-apartment energy inventory.

sample.accessibility_type_description: Configuration of entrance does not fit into any of the other categories

method.clue: EPSG:7855. Point-in-footprint; multiple footprints retained as ambiguous. If none, nearest footprint within 5 m is proximity only. Dwellings join by CLUE property ID; never sum counts over matched footprints.
method.udp: 2022 and 2025 snapshots only; latest snapshot for each project ID. Associate only if at least 50% of footprint area intersects project polygon in its council. Retain actual overlap; no legal-use certification.
method.omissions: A review queue, not confirmed missing apartments. Separate property evidence, completed-site associations and weak size/class heuristics. Do not add these records to rankings.
method.height: Origin of the value actually used. Council model takes precedence over unused Overture height. Microsoft height is an ML estimate even when the original file says SOURCE_HEIGHT. Floors convert at approximately 3.32 m per floor.
method.limits: No site visits, occupancy-certificate audit, or independent complete height ground truth. No address-level energy ratings/equipment obtained. Policy definitions are review criteria, not evidence that a particular building complies.
method.failedSources: UDP WFS attempts for 2021, 2023 and 2024 returned HTTP 400. The WFS capability catalogue was then checked: it advertised mrs2016, mrs2022 and mrs2025. The 2016 dataset is explicitly marked obsolete by DataVic and was not used. The retrieved 2022/2025 pair is not a continuous completion register; project status is dated to its snapshot, not asserted current in 2026.

catalogueCheck.reason: Officially marked obsolete; not used for current building corroboration.
